STREAM_WATCHDOG.OFFLINE_PLAYLIST_NAME_DESC: Name of the Volumio playlist to play, always shuffled, when your stream fails. Create it in Browse → Playlists before any failure occurs. Without it, the whole local library is played.
STREAM_WATCHDOG.RESTORE_CHECK_INTERVAL_DESC: While the offline playlist plays, how often to check whether the stream is back. Doubles after each try that fails, up to 10 minutes. Minimum: 30
STREAM_WATCHDOG.AUTO_RESTORE_DESC: Automatically resume the original stream when it comes back
